note: Oberbank's fee information document (1 October 2026): the be(e) green account, a package with a debit card, a Mastercard credit card and unlimited automated transactions, costs 37.00 euros a quarter to 31 December 2026 and 38.18 from 1 January 2027. Read again 2026-10-30 (each figure until 31 December 2026, then the second): online transfers cost nothing; a paper or foreign transfer 5.75 EUR (5.93 from 2027), written as the transfer abroad; cash at any Bankomat nothing (the shared Austrian network, own and other); notice that a payment wasn't carried out 7.60 EUR (7.84), written as the returned payment; a review on going past the overdraft line 4.53 EUR (4.67), written as the fee for each item paid into overdraft. The form's single figures can't carry their 2027 changes. Not stated: the overdraft rate, interest, the card's share on another currency, what opening asks.
